collection.title: Class 9 Competitive Exam Question Bank
collection.description: 160 Curated competitive exam questions with worked solutions across NTSE-style MAT/SAT, NSO Science Olympiad, IMO Maths Olympiad, and IEO English Olympiad.

items.subject: Mental Ability (MAT)
items.body: Find the missing number in the series: 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, ?

metadata.solution: Pattern: Each number is formed by multiplying the previous term by 2 and adding 1. 3×2+1=7; 7×2+1=15; 15×2+1=31; 31×2+1=63; Next term = 63×2 + 1 = 127.

items.subject: Scholastic Aptitude (SAT)
items.body: A car accelerates uniformly from rest to a speed of 72 km/h in 10 seconds. Calculate the acceleration and distance covered in this time interval.
items.latex: u = 0, v = 72\text{ km/h} = 20\text{ m/s}, t = 10\text{ s}

metadata.solution: Convert speed v = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Using v = u + at ⟹ 20 = 0 + a(10) ⟹ a = 2 m/s². Distance s = ut + ½at² = 0 + ½(2)(10²) = 100 meters.

items.subject: Mental Ability (MAT)
items.body: A person walks 8 km North, then turns East and walks 6 km. How far is he from the starting point and in which direction?

metadata.solution: Form a right-angled triangle with sides 8 km and 6 km. Hypotenuse = √(8² + 6²) = √(64 + 36) = √100 = 10 km. Direction is North-East.

items.subject: Scholastic Aptitude (SAT)
items.body: In 18th-century pre-revolutionary France, which Estate paid all the direct tax known as 'Taille'?

metadata.solution: The Third Estate, comprising peasants, workers, merchants, and educated professionals (98% of the population), bore the entire burden of taxes including Taille and Tithe.

items.subject: Science (NSO)
items.body: If the distance between two mass bodies is halved while their masses remain unchanged, what happens to the gravitational force of attraction between them?

metadata.solution: F ∝ 1/r². When distance r is reduced to r/2, new force F' = G m₁ m₂ / (r/2)² = 4 × (G m₁ m₂ / r²) = 4 F. The force becomes 4 times (quadrupled).

items.subject: Science (NSO)
items.body: Which separation method is used to separate a mixture of Ammonium Chloride (NH₄Cl) and Common Salt (NaCl)?

metadata.solution: Ammonium Chloride sublimes upon heating (directly converts from solid to vapor), whereas Sodium Chloride does not. Sublimation yields pure NH₄Cl on the inverted funnel.

items.subject: Science (NSO)
items.body: What happens to a plant cell when placed in a hypertonic solution for 30 minutes?

options: Plasmolysis occurs (cytoplasm shrinks away from cell wall)
metadata.solution: In a hypertonic solution (higher solute concentration outside), water leaves the plant cell via exosmosis, causing the protoplasm to shrink away from the rigid cell wall (Plasmolysis).

items.subject: Mathematics (IMO)
items.body: Find the remainder when p(x) = x³ - 3x² + 4x - 5 is divided by (x - 2).

metadata.solution: By the Remainder Theorem, dividing p(x) by (x - 2) gives remainder R = p(2). p(2) = 2³ - 3(2²) + 4(2) - 5 = 8 - 12 + 8 - 5 = -1.

items.subject: Mathematics (IMO)
items.body: In a triangle ABC, line DE is parallel to BC cutting AB at D and AC at E. If AD = 3 cm, DB = 6 cm, and AE = 4 cm, find the length of AC.

metadata.solution: By Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales Theorem), AD/DB = AE/EC ⟹ 3/6 = 4/EC ⟹ ½ = 4/EC ⟹ EC = 8 cm. Total length AC = AE + EC = 4 + 8 = 12 cm.

items.subject: English (IEO)
items.body: Choose the grammatically correct option: 'Neither of the candidates _____ submitted their documents yet.'

metadata.solution: 'Neither' is a singular indefinite pronoun requiring a singular verb. The correct auxiliary verb is 'has'.

items.subject: English (IEO)
items.body: What does the idiom 'To burn the midnight oil' mean?

options: To study or work late into the night
metadata.solution: 'To burn the midnight oil' means to work or study late into the night.
